title: RPCS3 0.0.32-16804: official stable release
summary: RPCS3 published 0.0.32-16804 on August 12, 2024. The release record documents an official stable release for the PlayStation 3 emulator project.

blocks.text: The RPCS3 project published version 0.0.32-16804 on August 12, 2024. GitHub marks this entry as a release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.

The release record publishes a SHA-256 checksum (ed274c2642c96e910a9b4aa080863d1b436414b91ba7a5fd7bbb2bf67b5cb7cd) and records an archive size of 29545792 bytes, approximately 29.5 MB. These values identify the distributed build without relying on an external summary.
